title: ResolutionEvent
description: 最近切换 feed entry. ADAPTER-OWNED: our adapter classifies per-source outcomes and emits these; the engine's own usage feed stays disabled because it leaks inbound keys (S1 gap ②). Redaction invariant: no credential material, no raw upstream error bodies.

kind.description: v2 adds `needs_action`: a source stopped being usable in a way that will not heal itself (OAuth expired, balance exhausted, key revoked). Without it the feed would have to file such a source under `cooldown`, which promises an automatic recovery that is never coming.

reason.description: Canonical error classification lives in the adapter (S1 gap ①): param/protocol/tool-compat errors surface to the caller and never produce switch events. `reason` is required, so v2 adds the four needs_action causes — without them a `kind: needs_action` event would have to borrow a self-healing reason like `quota_exhausted` and the feed would misstate what happened. They map 1:1 onto source `state.detail_key`: credential_expired→models.source.needs_action.oauth_expired, credential_revoked→.credential_revoked, balance_exhausted→.balance_exhausted, account_banned→.account_banned. Note the deliberate pair: `quota_exhausted` is a subscription cycle running out (self-healing, resets) while `balance_exhausted` is prepaid credit hitting zero (needs a top-up).

billing_note.description: drives the gold dot in frame V6 01

severity.description: v2 (2026-07-29): the notification tier, decided once at emit time (spec §4.5). info = self-healing (switch/cooldown/recover) — appears in the 最近切换 feed ONLY, never an IM push. action_required = the user owes an action (needs_action sources, an interrupted agent chain) — proactive IM push in colleague voice. The push layer MUST key off this field rather than re-deriving urgency from `kind`, so 'when do we interrupt the user' has exactly one definition. Optional in this schema only because the shipped v1 emitter predates it; it becomes REQUIRED at the API boundary in the serializer PR (README → Required-vs-optional).
